This '''individual''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Musician/Legends|musician]] who played a stringed instrument and was a member of a [[Unidentified Kuratooine band|band]].<ref name="MK" />

In [[44 ABY]],<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[X-Wing: Mercy Kill]]'' to [[44 ABY]].</ref> their band was busking for [[credcoin]]s at an open market near the [[Old Kura City Courthouse Plaza]] in [[Kura City]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kuratooine]]. [[Voort saBinring]], a member of the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] [[Commando/Legends|commando]] unit [[Wraith Squadron]], approached them with an offer. He gave them a [[credcard]] containing a thousand [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] in exchange for playing loud music that he could dance to, which the band agreed to. They played a loud rendition of ''[[Torrid Yavin]]'', an anthem for the rebuilding of the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. saBinring began dancing to the music and slowly gained an enthusiastic audience, which was all part of his plan to gather witnesses as he and the Wraiths exposed the criminal activities of Galactic Alliance [[Galactic Alliance Army|Army]] [[General/Legends|General]] [[Stavin Thaal]], who was in the vicinity.<ref name="MK" />
